patterns.dedup_note: 'responds to 5-10% of odours' is a statement about the odour set, so each distinct pattern counts once rather than once per time the game dealt it
patterns.filter: relay block non-zero AND sel_none bit (26) on AND episode >= 1000
patterns.seed_disjointness: bc2 episodes come from seeds 0-1359 (heuristic teacher) and 500000-501358 (random), disjoint from the plasticity calib (300000+), train (200000+) and eval (100000-100059) seeds by construction

rule: offset_i += k * log((r_i + eps) / (target + eps)); r_i measured on the CALIBRATION patterns only; no labels, no reward, no readout
v0_floor_note: per-cell lower clamp max(-10, v0_i - V_TH + 0.25): a threshold below the cell's own fixed v0 makes it spike on tick 1 for every odour
